purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche O certification benchmark authored only after r25 was merged, deployed, and current-live-publication verification succeeded. It was not used to construct r25 and stresses unused card text, replacement-like battle effects, cross-authority interactions, rules gaps, and scope restraint.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored only after production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded for v071-qa-20260918-25; it was not used to construct r25.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade tranche O after its first paid live run; preserve that run as immutable blind evidence.
Any failed tranche-O case may become regression coverage only after diagnosis and may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche O, certify the changed behavior with a newly authored blind tranche.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N questions.
Question-scoped semantic criteria require only what the question asks.
expectedSourceGroups are OR-lists within a governing requirement; separate groups remain independently required.

cases.question: I play Accusation for its Action effect and choose a card in the opponent's Discard Pile. Who decides whether it goes on top of their Draw Pile or into their Graveyard?
expectedSourceGroups: They put it on top of their Draw Pile or in their Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: The opponent decides whether the chosen card goes on top of their Draw Pile or into their Graveyard.

cases.question: I use Act of Faith's Action effect. How many cards may I reveal from the top of the opponent's Draw Pile, and where do they go?
expectedSourceGroups: Reveal up to three cards from the top of the opponent's Draw Pile. Put one in their Graveyard and the rest in their Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Reveal up to three; put one in their Graveyard and the rest in their Discard Pile.

cases.question: Armistice is banked. Can either player start a battle while it remains active?
expectedSourceGroups: Neither player can start a battle

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Neither player can start a battle while Armistice is active.

cases.question: Armistice is used as a Gambit or Tactic. What happens to the attacker and to the other Gambits and Tactics still in battle?
expectedSourceGroups: The attacker withdraws. Put every other Gambit and Tactic still in battle in its owner's Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: The attacker withdraws, and every other Gambit and Tactic still in battle goes to its owner's Discard Pile.

cases.question: What does Assassins do when played for its Action effect?
expectedSourceGroups: Reveal the opponent's Hand. Choose one card there and discard it

semanticCriteria.statement: Reveal the opponent's Hand, choose one card there, and discard it.

cases.question: I use Assassins as a Gambit or Tactic, but the opponent set no Gambit. What happens?
expectedSourceGroups: If the opponent set no Gambit, the opponent gains Disadvantage

semanticCriteria.statement: The opponent gains Disadvantage.

cases.question: Attrition is banked and the opponent loses the battle. Where do their Tactics from that battle go in the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: put each opposing Tactic from this battle in their Graveyard instead of their Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Their Tactics from that battle go to their Graveyard instead of their Discard Pile.

cases.question: I use Attrition as a Gambit or Tactic and the opponent loses. What happens to the cards from their initial Reserve?
expectedSourceGroups: put every card from their initial Reserve in their Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Every card from the opponent's initial Reserve goes to their Graveyard.

cases.question: When may I play Battlefield Promotion for its Action effect, and what card can it return?
expectedSourceGroups: Play only during Denouement if you won a battle this turn. Return one Tactic you chose during that battle from your Discard Pile to your Hand

semanticCriteria.statement: Only during Denouement after you won a battle that turn; it returns one Tactic you chose during that battle from your Discard Pile to your Hand.

cases.question: Bombardment is an Overlay on a Territory. What happens to that Territory's printed effect while the Overlay remains there?
expectedSourceGroups: This Territory's printed effect is inactive

semanticCriteria.statement: The Territory's printed effect is inactive.

cases.question: I capture a Territory carrying my Bombardment Overlay without a battle. What happens to the Overlay?
expectedSourceGroups: If you capture this Territory without a battle, turn this Overlay into Ruins

semanticCriteria.statement: Turn the Bombardment Overlay into Ruins.

cases.question: Brothers in Arms is banked. While choosing Tactics, I did not set a Gambit. What may I do with Brothers in Arms?
expectedSourceGroups: if you did not set a Gambit, you may discard this card for +1 Tactic from Hand

semanticCriteria.statement: You may discard Brothers in Arms for +1 Tactic from Hand.

cases.question: I choose Brothers in Arms as a Tactic without having set a Gambit, and use its +1 Tactic from Hand. Where does that added Tactic go in the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: In the Aftermath, put that card in your Graveyard instead of your Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: The added Tactic from Hand goes to your Graveyard instead of your Discard Pile.

cases.question: Burning at the Stake reveals an opponent's Hand and two cards are tied for highest card value. Who chooses which tied card goes to the Graveyard?
expectedSourceGroups: Put the card there with the highest card value in their Graveyard; choose among ties

semanticCriteria.statement: The Inquisition player using Burning at the Stake chooses among the tied highest-value cards.

cases.question: I use Capital Punishment as a Gambit or Tactic and choose an opposing battle card whose effect has not happened yet. What happens now, and what happens to that chosen card if I win?
expectedSourceGroups: Negate one opposing Gambit or Tactic that has not taken effect. In the Aftermath, if you win, put the chosen card in its owner's Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Negate the chosen Gambit or Tactic; if you win, put that chosen card in its owner's Graveyard in the Aftermath.

cases.question: A battle is taking place on Circle of Bones. After dice are rolled, how often may its reroll effect be used and what is its cost?
expectedSourceGroups: Once during each battle here, after dice are rolled, you may put one card from your Hand in your Graveyard to make either player reroll

semanticCriteria.statement: Once during that battle; put one card from your Hand in your Graveyard to make either player reroll.

cases.question: When can I play Consolidation for its Action effect, and what does it give me?
expectedSourceGroups: Play only if you captured a Territory this turn. +2 Cards

semanticCriteria.statement: Only if you captured a Territory that turn; it gives +2 Cards.

cases.question: I use Contraband as a Gambit or Tactic and choose an eligible card in my Discard Pile. In what role and face state is that card placed, and what is its default Aftermath destination?
expectedSourceGroups: place the chosen card face up in the same role. In the Aftermath, put the chosen card in your Graveyard unless its text says otherwise

semanticCriteria.statement: Place the chosen card face up in Contraband's same role; by default it goes to your Graveyard in the Aftermath unless its own text says otherwise.

cases.question: Counterworks is banked and an opposing effect would place an Overlay on a Territory. What may Counterworks do to the Overlay and the card that would become it?
expectedSourceGroups: discard this card to prevent that Overlay. The card that would become that Overlay is discarded

semanticCriteria.statement: You may discard Counterworks to prevent the Overlay; the card that would have become the Overlay is discarded.

cases.question: An opposing effect would Remove two of my other Assets while Decoys is banked. What can Decoys save?
expectedSourceGroups: you may discard this card to keep one of them in play

semanticCriteria.statement: You may discard Decoys to keep one of those other Assets in play.

cases.question: Disruption negates an opposing battle card before it takes effect. Where is a Gambit returned, where is a Tactic returned, and can that same card be used again in this battle?
expectedSourceGroups: Return a Gambit to its owner's Hand or a Tactic to its owner's Reserve. That specific card cannot be set or chosen again during this battle

semanticCriteria.statement: A Gambit returns to its owner's Hand, a Tactic returns to its owner's Reserve, and that specific card cannot be used again in the battle.

cases.question: What does Divine Mercy do when played for its Action effect?
expectedSourceGroups: Choose one card in the opponent's Graveyard and move it to their Discard Pile. Then +2 Conviction

semanticCriteria.statement: Move one chosen card from the opponent's Graveyard to their Discard Pile, then gain 2 Conviction.

cases.question: Entrenchment is banked and the opponent advances onto a Territory adjacent to my Player Token. What two restrictions hit that opponent?
expectedSourceGroups: their movement ends and they cannot play a card for its Action effect during their Denouement that turn

semanticCriteria.statement: Their movement ends, and they cannot play a card for its Action effect during their Denouement that turn.

cases.question: I play Excommunication for its Action effect. What is the maximum combined card value I can move from the opponent's Discard Pile, and where do those cards go?
expectedSourceGroups: combined card value up to 5. Put them in their Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Choose cards with combined value up to 5 and put them in the opponent's Graveyard.

cases.question: What is the cost and movement benefit of Fate's Toll's Action effect?
expectedSourceGroups: Put one other card from your Hand in your Graveyard. Move one additional Position this turn

semanticCriteria.statement: Put one other Hand card in your Graveyard to gain one additional Position of movement that turn.

cases.question: I use Fate's Toll as a Gambit or Tactic and have already rolled. What may I do to reroll?
expectedSourceGroups: After you roll, you may put one other card from your Hand in your Graveyard to reroll

semanticCriteria.statement: After you roll, you may put one other card from Hand in your Graveyard to reroll.

cases.question: Fealty is banked. Can an opposing card effect give me Disadvantage?
expectedSourceGroups: Opposing card effects cannot give you Disadvantage

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Opposing card effects cannot give you Disadvantage while Fealty is active.

cases.question: Field Command is banked. After I use one of my Leader's 1-Command Orders, what can Field Command let me do with the other 1-Command Order?
expectedSourceGroups: use your Leader's other 1-Command Order at its next legal timing this turn without spending Command

semanticCriteria.statement: You may discard Field Command to use the other 1-Command Order at its next legal timing that turn without spending Command.

cases.question: I used Good Faith when offering Terms and set a Hand card aside. The Terms are refused. Where does that set-aside card go and when?
expectedSourceGroups: Refused — Return it to your Hand before Gambits are set

semanticCriteria.statement: Return the set-aside card to your Hand before Gambits are set.

cases.question: What two cards does Soul for Soul exchange when played for its Action effect?
expectedSourceGroups: Choose one card in your Hand and one card in your Graveyard. Exchange them

semanticCriteria.statement: Exchange one chosen card in your Hand with one chosen card in your Graveyard.

cases.question: After battle cards are cleared at Spirit Hollow, what optional exchange-like procedure may each player perform?
expectedSourceGroups: each player may put one card from their Hand in their Graveyard. A player who does may move one other card from their Graveyard to their Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Each player may put one Hand card in their Graveyard; a player who does may move one other Graveyard card to their Discard Pile.

cases.question: Supplies is banked. When may I discard it for cards, and how many cards do I get?
expectedSourceGroups: After your normal Draw, you may discard this card for +2 Cards

semanticCriteria.statement: After your normal Draw, you may discard Supplies to gain 2 Cards.

cases.question: What does Tactical Planning do when played for its Action effect?
expectedSourceGroups: +2 Cards, then place one card from your Hand on the bottom of your Draw Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Gain 2 Cards, then place one card from your Hand on the bottom of your Draw Pile.

cases.question: I set Tactical Planning as a Gambit. When Gambits reveal, what does it change about Reserve and Tactic limit?
expectedSourceGroups: When Gambits are revealed: +1 Reserve. Tactic limit unchanged

semanticCriteria.statement: You gain +1 Reserve, and your Tactic limit does not change.

cases.question: Treason chooses an opposing Gambit or Tactic effect that has not taken effect yet. What does Treason do to that effect?
expectedSourceGroups: Negate it, then apply that effect

semanticCriteria.statement: Treason negates the chosen opposing effect, then applies that effect.

cases.question: Tyranny is banked. How often per turn may I use its Asset effect, what does it cost, and what does it negate?
expectedSourceGroups: spend 1 Conviction to negate one of them

semanticCriteria.statement: Once per turn, when opposing Gambits or Tactics are revealed before their effects apply, spend 1 Conviction to negate one of them.

cases.question: Unbroken Ranks is banked and I win a battle in which I used no Orders. What may I do and what do I gain?
expectedSourceGroups: you may discard this card: +1 Command

semanticCriteria.statement: You may discard Unbroken Ranks to gain 1 Command.

cases.question: Valor is banked and I lose a battle. When does it give me a card?
expectedSourceGroups: Whenever you lose a battle, after you retreat, +1 Card

semanticCriteria.statement: After you retreat from the lost battle, gain 1 Card.

cases.question: I use War Crimes after winning. What three things am I forbidden to do as a result of that victory?
expectedSourceGroups: You cannot move, capture a Territory, or use an Order as a result of that victory

semanticCriteria.statement: You cannot move, capture a Territory, or use an Order as a result of that victory.

cases.question: War Witch is banked while I am choosing Tactics. What may I trade it for, and where does that chosen Tactic go in the Aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: +1 Tactic from your Graveyard. In the Aftermath, put that card in your Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: You may put War Witch in your Graveyard for +1 Tactic from your Graveyard; that chosen Tactic goes to your Graveyard in the Aftermath.

cases.question: What does Phantom Passage do when played for its Action effect?
expectedSourceGroups: Put this card in your Graveyard. Move to any Territory you control

semanticCriteria.statement: Put Phantom Passage in your Graveyard, then move to any Territory you control.

cases.question: Battlefield Plunder is an Overlay and a player starts their Opening on its Territory. What may that player do to the Overlay, and what do they get?
expectedSourceGroups: may put this card in its owner's Discard Pile. If they do, +2 Cards

semanticCriteria.statement: They may put Battlefield Plunder in its owner's Discard Pile; if they do, they gain 2 Cards.

cases.question: Reembodiment is banked. What event can trigger it, and what kind of card may it return from my Graveyard?
expectedSourceGroups: The first time each turn you put an Arcane card from your Hand in your Graveyard as a cost or part of an effect you control
return one other lower-value card from your Graveyard to your Hand

semanticCriteria.statement: The first such Arcane Hand-to-Graveyard event each turn can trigger it; after that effect resolves, it may return one other lower-value Graveyard card to your Hand.

cases.question: The opponent's Bombardment effect would place its Overlay on a Territory while I have Counterworks banked. If I discard Counterworks, what happens to Bombardment?
expectedSourceGroups: When an opposing effect would place an Overlay on a Territory, you may discard this card to prevent that Overlay. The card that would become that Overlay is discarded
place this Overlay face up there

semanticCriteria.statement: Counterworks prevents the Bombardment Overlay from being placed, and the Bombardment card is discarded.

cases.question: The opponent uses Entrenchment as a Gambit or Tactic while I have Fealty banked. Can Entrenchment give me Disadvantage?
expectedSourceGroups: Opposing card effects cannot give you Disadvantage

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Fealty prevents the opposing Entrenchment card effect from giving you Disadvantage.

cases.question: A face-down card falls off the table and both players accidentally see it. Does published v0.7.1 define an official procedure to restore the hidden information?

semanticCriteria.statement: Published v0.7.1 does not define an official repair procedure for accidentally revealed hidden information; the Arbiter should identify the gap and may issue a clearly provisional table ruling.

cases.question: Which leader has the strongest tournament deck right now?

semanticCriteria.statement: This asks for competitive strategy or balance judgment rather than a gameplay-rules ruling, so the Rules Arbiter should give a concise scope boundary.
